index.businessHint: Name, addresses, phones, business number and VAT mode.
index.checkoutHint: Hold times, limits, exchange rates and payment providers.
index.shippingHint: Zones, rates, surcharges, insurance and caps.

freshHint: Changing settings requires a sign-in within the last half hour.

business.title: Business details
business.idNumberHint: Shown only in documents, emails and non-indexed pages – never on the legal pages or in the footer.
business.vatExplain: An osek patur charges no VAT and issues receipts. An osek murshe includes VAT in the price (18%) and issues tax invoice/receipts. Prices on the site are always the final consumer price. Shipments abroad are exports (0% VAT, to be confirmed by the accountant). Check with the accountant before changing this.
business.completed: The details are complete and current (required before going live)

checkout.title: Checkout and payments
checkout.maxHoldsPerArtworkPerBuyer24h: Holds of the same work per buyer in 24 h
checkout.maxWebHoldSpanMinutes: Maximum total hold span on the site (minutes)
checkout.paypalForIsraeliDestinations: Offer PayPal for deliveries in Israel too
checkout.receiptForRefundedPayments: Issue a receipt for refunded payments too (per the accountant)
checkout.conversationLookbackDays: Window for detecting an earlier conversation (days)
checkout.providersHint: Set in the server's environment variables. Secrets are never shown.
